verdict.rationale: Ramp docs mention virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits, entity-level restrictions, and OAuth scopes like cards:write/limits:read/limits:write suggesting granular per-card controls exist, but there is no direct first-party documentation of a finance-lead UI flow for setting individual employee spend limits, category restrictions, or merchant-level controls per card, nor independent/community confirmation of this specific workflow. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the per-employee card limit-setting UI/workflow, granular control categories (merchant/category/time-based limits) beyond vendor-level examples, and independent or hands-on verification of this specific finance-lead control experience.
